messages:
Esha P.: Hey team — enterprise customer reported sudden 429s for one project even though the project quota tile shows plenty of headroom. They hit rate limits repeatedly around 10:22 UTC and dashboard doesn’t align with enforcement logs. Repro steps and curl below. Can we triage?

Esha P.: Repro (redacted keys):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"model":"gpt-open-16k","input":"ping"}'
```
They got 429s at 2026-03-16T10:22:07Z but quota tile for project p-12 shows 89% available for rolling 1h window.

audit-bot: Ticket #6421 created for customer "Acme Logistics" (sev 2) and linked to this thread.

Alex B.: Thanks Esha. Can you paste org id + project id and a sample request id from the 429 response (x-request-id)? Also which dashboard view (project vs org) showed the mismatch?

Esha P.: Org id: org-87, Project id: p-12, sample x-request-id: rq_20260316_102207_9f3b. The project tile (top-right) is the one showing available tokens. Org aggregate looked slightly lower but still not matching enforcement.

Jun L.: I can pull enforcement logs. Quick note: our rate limiter enforces a sliding (rolling) window; the dashboard aggregation pipeline historically used fixed minute buckets then summed them. If requests cluster at bucket boundaries that can under/over represent the true rolling count.

Maya R.: Yep, we shipped a metric pipeline tweak last month that changed bucket alignment to local-minute boundaries for perf. I wonder if DST/UTC conversion or the new alignment combined with our upsert race left stale counts for p-12.

eng-runtime-oncall: Investigated — aggregation service (metrics-agg v2) is sampling into 60s buckets and then we sum buckets for the UI. The limiter uses a 3600s rolling window implemented via ring buffer of events. When a burst arrives exactly at boundary we double-count in the UI path because of an off-by-one overlap in the rebase logic. That explains spikes like you saw at 10:22.

eng-runtime-oncall: Repro steps I used: replayed traffic for p-12 using recorded request timestamps and compared two calculations:
1) rolling_count = sliding_window_count(events, now-3600, now)
2) ui_count = sum(bucket_counts[from=(now-3600, step=60s)])
I saw ui_count varying by +/− 3–7% vs rolling_count around heavy bursts.

Alex B.: Can we backfill/fix customer-facing numbers quickly? They are escalated.

eng-runtime-oncall: Short term mitigation: 1) disable the new alignment (roll back to UTC-aligned buckets) in metrics-agg config for the org shard org-87 — this will reduce misalignment within ~2 mins. 2) enqueue backfill job to reaggregate the last 24h for p-12 (priority high).

Maya R.: Also will add a dashboard flag that shows "enforcement window vs UI window" mismatch for tiles so CS can surface it.

eng-runtime-oncall: Patch PR: https://git.redwood.ai/metrics/metrics-agg/pulls/219 — deploying config rollback to canary in us-west now (deploy id: deploy-85f7). Backfill job started at 2026-03-16T11:03:45Z, ETA ~18m for last 24h for p-12.

Esha P.: Thanks. I notified the customer and suggested temporary retries with exponential backoff + 500ms jitter and to expect visible dashboard correction in ~20–30m. Will update ticket #6421.

Alex B.: After backfill finishes please post the reaggregated numbers and enforcement logs for rq_20260316_102207_9f3b. We'll verify no billing impact.

eng-runtime-oncall: Backfill finished at 2026-03-16T11:22:01Z. For rq_20260316_102207_9f3b enforcement path shows 429 triggered by sliding_window_count=1001 against limit=1000. UI pre-fix showed 997 available which was inaccurate due to overlap. We reindexed tiles and corrected display. No retroactive billing charge was created; usage ledger uses enforcement events.

Maya R.: Follow-up action items: 1) revert metric alignment permanently until we implement overlap-safe aggregation (owner: metrics team). 2) add a regression test that simulates boundary bursts (owner: eng-qa). 3) add CS dashboard flag to surface mismatch (owner: product).

Esha P.: Customer updated and is happy to have numbers align. Keeping ticket open for 24h to watch for recurrence. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
